id_and_class.summary: Björn Merker argues that basic phenomenal consciousness is generated by an ancient upper-brainstem system, centered on the midbrain, that can work without the cerebral cortex. This system runs an analog simulation of a body nested in a world around an implicit ego-center, letting the animal match needs to opportunities; the cortex enriches the content of that simulation but does not constitute it.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as a Midbrain Simulation of Body-in-World

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is the structured analog simulation, or ‘reality space’, in which a simulated body sits inside a simulated world around an ego-center, colored by motivational bias.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Phenomenal experience is the mode of function of a specific brain architecture: the format of a neural simulation built to solve a control problem.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Weak emergence, from the organization of a mesodiencephalic simulation. Merker treats it as architectonic: present when the right interface exists, absent otherwise.
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: The simulation places the origin of its body-world coordinates in the head of the simulated body. That ego-center is where the subject is, which explains the asymmetry between subject and object and why the vantage point never appears as an object.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Experience is perspectival, body-in-world and motivationally colored because that is how the simulation is structured. Merker points to the empty, Cyclops-like aperture through which we face the world, where our own face should be, as evidence that experienced body and world are synthetic.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Superior colliculus maps, basal-ganglia and nigral circuits, periaqueductal gray, hypothalamus, and the analog neural simulation they jointly implement.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Comparative neuroanatomy, decortication studies in animals, clinical observation of children born without cortex, and imaging of collicular activity.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A selection triangle of target selection, action selection and motivational ranking, integrated in one coordinate frame in the midbrain and basal diencephalon; cortex differentiates, stabilizes and conceptualizes content.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Basic phenomenal consciousness and the first-person perspective; reflective self-awareness is treated as an add-on of big-brained species.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: The selection triangle: target, action and motivation constrain one another inside a shared analog simulation, and the structure of that simulation is a conscious mode of function.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: An ongoing real-time simulation that converts the hemispheres' parallel processing into the sequential, limited-capacity mode coherent behavior needs.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Midbrain and basal diencephalon, especially the superior colliculus; every forebrain contribution to behavior passes a narrow bottleneck at the midbrain-diencephalon junction.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness solves real-time decision-making for a mobile body by matching needs to opportunities in one integrated framework.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: The superior colliculus superposes the spatial senses topographically in a common premotor frame, joined by basal-ganglia action signals and motivational input from the hypothalamus and periaqueductal gray.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Merker's later work describes a subcortical ‘global best estimate buffer’ and places the first-person pivot in the cortical efference cascade converging on subcortical way stations.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: The architecture is evolutionarily ancient and vertebrate-wide; a jellyfish nerve net is excluded by lacking the interface, not by being simple.
core_claims_and_evidence: Penfield and Jasper found that removing large sectors of cortex, even a whole hemisphere, never interrupted the continuity of consciousness.
Decorticate rats groom, play, mate and raise pups, and decorticate cats solve visual discriminations.
Shewmon and colleagues judged four congenitally decorticate children conscious by ordinary neurological criteria, and Merker reports their preferences and pleasure.
Merker predicts that no change in conscious content occurs without mesodiencephalic involvement, citing collicular activation during an audio-visual illusion under fixation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Empirical: comparative neuroanatomy, lesion studies and clinical observation, with a theoretical argument from control architecture.

empirics_and_critiques.known_empirical_interventions_or_tests: Decortication in mammals, observation of children with hydranencephaly, and imaging of collicular activity during illusions under maintained fixation.
empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Critics object that organized behavior in decorticate animals and children does not establish phenomenal experience. Merker replies that classifying such children as vegetative assumes the cortex-consciousness identity under dispute.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: The evidence does not settle whether the mesodiencephalic system constitutes consciousness or only enables cortically elaborated contents; Merker frames the collicular prediction as the route to a verdict.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Coherent within physicalism; it inverts the corticocentric consensus rather than departing from naturalism.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Merker ties consciousness to a specific simulation architecture; whether an artificial system implementing the selection triangle would be conscious is left open.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since consciousness is the function of a midbrain simulation, it ends with the brain.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: The theory explains consciousness as a solution to a biological control problem.

virtual_immortality.rationale: The theory does not address simulated continuation of a person.
